name: opencode-plugin-serial
description: opencode plugin: serial-port tools (serial_*) + live TUI monitor with an interactive input line (tab completion, history, reverse-i-search). Open/read/write serial devices, server-side reactive triggers (e.g. u-boot break), server-side log de-noising (dedup/cycles/normalize/digest), a device map + per-device lease (one writer, many observers), an auto-appearing bottom status bar, and a shared session the agent and user both watch over a self-hosted /serial WebSocket. Standalone — no opencode core changes.
